sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int[]; arr int[] := ARRAY[[1,2],[3,4]]; BEGIN FOREACH x SLICE 1 IN ARRAY arr LOOP NULL; END LOOP; END $$;

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int[][]; arr int[] := ARRAY[[1,2],[3,4]]; BEGIN FOREACH x SLICE 2 IN ARRAY arr LOOP NULL; END LOOP; END $$;

sql: DO $$ DECLARE i int := 0; BEGIN <<myloop>> LOOP i := i + 1; EXIT myloop WHEN i >= 3; END LOOP myloop; END $$;
note: labeled LOOP with EXIT label and END LOOP label

sql: DO $$ DECLARE i int := 0; BEGIN <<wloop>> WHILE i < 10 LOOP i := i + 1; CONTINUE wloop WHEN i < 5; NULL; END LOOP wloop; END $$;
note: labeled WHILE with CONTINUE label WHEN

sql: DO $$ DECLARE i int; BEGIN <<outer>> FOR i IN 1..5 LOOP <<inner>> FOR i IN 1..5 LOOP EXIT outer WHEN i = 3; END LOOP inner; END LOOP outer; END $$;
note: nested FOR loops EXIT outer label

sql: DO $$ DECLARE i int; BEGIN <<outer>> FOR i IN 1..5 LOOP <<inner>> FOR i IN 1..5 LOOP CONTINUE outer WHEN i = 2; END LOOP inner; END LOOP outer; END $$;
note: nested FOR loops CONTINUE outer label

sql: DO $$ DECLARE i int := 0; BEGIN LOOP EXIT; END LOOP; END $$;
